name: Nor-Tag
summary:
Welcome to the wild, whimsical world of Nor-Tag, a unique social game where you're transformed into a mischievous monkey with only arms! In Nor-Tag, the jungle is your playground, and fun is always within reach.

Swing from tree to tree using just your arms, mastering the art of agile navigation. Challenge your friends in a series of hilarious mini-games designed to test your monkey skills. Whether it's a high-flying swinging race through the treetops or a frantic banana-throwing contest, Nor-Tag offers end
